[EN] Mission Orders

The cultist stragglers in the Bastion of Lok are plotting against the federation.

Destroy the {@LinkCreature:487#1001#devan assassins}, {@LinkCreature:487#1002#devan shamans}, {@LinkCreature:487#1003#devan butchers}, and {@LinkCreature:487#1004#devan reapers}.

Report to the nearest coordinator when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los rezagados cultistas en Bastion of Lok están conspirando contra la federación.

Destruye a los {@LinkCreature:487#1001#devan assassins}, {@LinkCreature:487#1002#devan shamans}, {@LinkCreature:487#1003#devan butchers} y {@LinkCreature:487#1004#devan reapers}.

Preséntate ante el coordinador más cercano cuando completes la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation.
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación.

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
